title: Maternal mortality rate for Black women (deaths per 100,000 live births)

source.name: Maternal Mortality Rates in the United States, 2022 and 2023 (Health E-Stat)
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: While the national rate fell every year after 2021, NCHS reports the rate for non-Hispanic Black women plateaued: 69.9 (2021), 49.5 (2022), 50.3 (2023) per 100,000 live births; NCHS notes the 2022-to-2023 increase was not statistically significant.
